description: Allows to create custom data detectors.

ID.description: ID is the identifier of the object.
ID.title: ID

activation.description: The activation in progress, if any.
activation.title: activation

anchors.description: Legacy example sentences, accepted on creation and import only. They become the first version of the corpus, activated without evaluation. Author a corpus in `draft` instead.
anchors.title: anchors

corpus.description: The live corpus, the one used for detection.
corpus.title: corpus

description.description: Description of the custom data type.
description.title: description

draft.description: Unpublished changes. Once the custom data type has a corpus, every change to `matches` or to the corpus is made here and goes live on activation.
draft.title: draft

evaluationInputs.description: What the corpus is evaluated against. Never used for detection.
evaluationInputs.title: evaluationInputs

importHash.description: The hash of the structure used to compare with new import version.
importHash.title: importHash

importLabel.description: The user-defined import label that allows the system to group resources from the same import operation.
importLabel.title: importLabel

ingestions.description: Where each corpus revision stands in each region.
ingestions.title: ingestions

lastEvaluation.description: The most recent evaluation of the draft.
lastEvaluation.title: lastEvaluation

levelsChanged.description: Whether the last evaluation gives the live version different Medium and High confidence thresholds than the ones it was activated with. Activating it again applies them. Computed on read, not stored.
levelsChanged.title: levelsChanged

matches.description: A list of RE2 regular expressions used for data detection. Each expression can include zero or one capturing group. If no capturing group is present, detection positions will be determined based on the entire captured portion of the data. If a single capturing group is included, the detection positions will correspond to the part defined by that group. More than one capturing group is refused on save. The analysis pipelines then validate them, refusing those too costly to run, and they go live only once validated. Once the custom data type has a corpus, change them in `draft`.
matches.title: matches

name.description: The internal reference name of the object. It is a sanitized version of Friendly Name if empty.
name.title: name

previous.description: The version live before the current one, kept for rollback.
previous.title: previous

propagate.description: Propagates the object to all child namespaces. This is always true.
propagate.title: propagate

status.description: Whether the custom data type detects. `Draft` has never been activated, `Activating` is being rolled out to every region, `Stuck` has a region that keeps failing while the previous version still detects, and `Active` detects everywhere.
status.title: status

updateTime.description: Last update date of the object.
updateTime.title: updateTime

title: CustomDataType
